text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia celebrates on Monday the eighth anniversary of the Arab Maghreb Union (UMA) grouping which includes Tunisia, Libya, Algeria, Morocco and Mauritania.
- Health minister Hedi Mhenni says that the cost of hospital reform is 42 million dinars.
- Tunisia exported 16,000 tonnes of dates since last October.
- President Ben Ali says in a message sent to leaders of the Arab Maghreb Union countries difficulties must be overcome to allow the grouping to continue.
